name: Ebed (Father of Gaal who challenged Abimelech in Shechem)
title: Father of Gaal
summary: Ebed is known only from the Bible as the father of Gaal, who led a revolt against Abimelech in Shechem. He is mentioned in the book of Judges chapter 9, where his son Gaal attempted to challenge Abimelech's rule over Shechem. Beyond this, there is no further information about Ebed's life or deeds in Scripture.

keyEvents.title: Gaal, son of Ebed, comes to Shechem
keyEvents.description: Gaal, son of Ebed, came to Shechem with his brothers, and the people of Shechem placed their trust in him.

keyEvents.title: Gaal challenges Abimelech
keyEvents.description: Gaal, son of Ebed, spoke openly against Abimelech during a festival at the temple of the god of Shechem and urged the people to rise up against him.

keyEvents.title: Zebul warns Abimelech
keyEvents.description: Zebul, the governor of Shechem, became angry when he heard the words of Gaal, son of Ebed, and sent word to Abimelech warning him of the revolt.

keyEvents.title: Gaal sees Abimelech's forces approaching
keyEvents.description: Gaal, son of Ebed, stood at the city gate as Abimelech and his men rose from ambush, and Zebul confronted Gaal with his own words.

keyEvents.title: Gaal is Defeated and Driven Away
keyEvents.description: Gaal son of Ebed went out against Abimelech but was defeated and driven away. Zebul then drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.
